summary.value: The northern fowl mite is a blood-feeding parasite that mainly targets wild birds but readily becomes established on egg-laying chickens, nesting in and around poultry coops. Heavy infestations cause economic loss through reduced egg production and feed efficiency, and can cause anemia or death in birds.
